name: Vrau: QUEER BAILE FUNK - CarnaVRAU Edition
description: CarnaVRAU, a special tribute to Brazilian Carnaval celebrating the freedom to express love, music and dance in the streets. VRAU is a Brazilian party created in Berlin with a focus on promoting Brazilian culture, celebrating the variety of music from Baile Funk to other Brazilian genres. A party made by queer people for everyone open to dance and celebrate Brazilian culture in Berlin's club scene.
